description: This Java class defines the DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy, which handles the deletion of a feature property within a 'Thing' object. It processes the DeleteFeatureProperty command, extracts the relevant feature and property, and generates corresponding deletion events and results.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the deletion of a feature property command for a 'Thing'. It implements logic to locate the feature and property, produce deletion events, and generate results or errors accordingly.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete feature property command, retrieving the feature and constructing a delete event and result if successful.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specified feature from the given 'Thing' based on the command.

methods.name: getDeleteFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Creates a result object representing the outcome of the delete operation, including event creation if the property exists.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Fetches the previous EntityTag of the feature property for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional as the next EntityTag is not computed in delete scenarios.
